name.description: The plugin's name; its folder has the same name

requires.description: The first Ardia version the plugin works with

keywords.description: Words that find the plugin in Settings

main.description: The plugin's JavaScript, like dist/index.js; a plugin has main or sidecar, not both

sidecar.description: A program Ardia runs beside the plugin; a plugin has main or sidecar, not both

activationEvents.description: When main starts; worked out from contributes when left out

tabs.description: read: see your tabs. write: also open them

fullUrls.description: See whole addresses, with what follows ? and #

activePage.description: Read the text of the tab you're on, for 30 seconds after you use the plugin

workspace.description: See and rearrange every window, tab and group (needs tabs: write and fullUrls)

network.description: false, "*" or hosts like api.example.com and *.example.com

control.description: Let programs you run drive your tabs and pages

open.description: Open the plugin's page as a tab, or in Split View beside the current tab

context.description: Hand the page the current tab (needs the tabs permission)

sideSetting.description: A choice row whose value picks the side

path.description: Where in the plugin's page to open, like /history

when.description: Shows only when this holds, like urlHost == "github.com" && !isPinned

view.description: Opens the command's view, which main renders

panel.description: Opens one of the plugin's panels

handler.description: main handles it; the default when there's a main and nothing else

programs.description: Commands Ardia puts on your PATH while the plugin is on

path.description: An executable file in the plugin's folder, like bin/tool

afterUpdate.description: Built-in plugins only: argument lists Ardia runs the program with, once per new version

example.description: A command to try, shown once the program is on PATH, like ardia tabs

claim.description: Built-in plugins only: reserves the name, so no other plugin can put a program with it on PATH

fill.description: system: macOS's Passwords panel fills the field. Managers with their own vault are credential providers (contributes.credentialProvider)

verificationCodeSetup.description: Offer to set up two-factor codes a page shows in the app macOS uses for otpauth links

passkeys.description: Show the host's passkey status on the plugin's Settings page

passwordManager.description: Makes the plugin a password manager each profile can pick in Settings › Profiles › Passwords

icon.description: A .png in the plugin's folder, at most 1 MB

type.description: secret: Ardia's native secure field; the plugin gets a single-use handle, never the text

masked.description: secret only: false shows what's typed, on the same native path

twoStep.description: fields only: the provider may ask for a two-step code

appURL.description: desktopApproval: the app's address, like onepassword://

field.description: A secret field of a method, asked for again to unlock

approvalHosts.description: Hosts (and their subdomains) whose https pages Ardia may open for an approval

name.description: A bare program name, found by Ardia's trusted locator

allowLocalHttp.description: url: also take http for localhost, 127.0.0.1 and ::1

credentialProvider.description: Official plugins only: a source of logins for Ardia's own password manager, driving a password manager's CLI through a typed verb catalog. A plugin with it has main only, no other contributions and no permissions

when.description: Shows only when this holds, like urlHost == "github.com" && !isPinned
Shows only when this holds, like urlHost == "github.com" && !isPinned

file.description: A page in the plugin's folder

global.description: Shows in every search; takes no keyword

file.description: A theme file in the plugin's folder

siteSwitches.description: Switches Site Controls shows for each http(s) site, kept per origin on this device

look.description: stripes: Arc's striped developer bar above the page, or in the toolbar's address field

siteSwitch.description: One of this plugin's siteSwitches: the bar shows on sites where it is on

localAddresses.description: A toggle row: while it is on, a local address typed in the address bar turns siteSwitch on for that site

buttons.description: Host actions in order; | is a divider

pageBar.description: A bar Ardia draws above the pages the plugin's site switch is on for, with buttons that run Ardia's own actions on that tab

alwaysOn.description: Built-in plugins only: once installed, no switch turns it off

official.description: Built-in plugins only: listed among Ardia's official plugins

autoInstall.description: Built-in plugins only, with alwaysOn: installed on a new profile with no click
